pages.text: $(d)Block Breaker$()$(br2)The $(d)Block Breaker$() will break the block in front of it. It has the equivalent of an unbreakable Iron Pickaxe.$(br2)Blocks broken will be placed into an inventory behind it, if one exists. Otherwise, it will drop to the floor behind it.

It can be disabled with a redstone signal.$(br2)$(d)Diamond Breaker$()$(br2)The $(d)Diamond Breaker$() can be applied to the Block Breaker to upgrade it, giving it the equivalent of a Diamond Pickaxe.
It can also be enchanted, and any enchantments will actually be applied when breaking blocks!
